preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(h) <= 1000 and 2 <= int(w) <= 1000 and 1 <= int(q) <= 10000 for h, w, q in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1]])
preconditions.description: Grid dimensions h and w are integers between 2 and 1000 inclusive, and number of days q is between 1 and 10000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) >= 2 + int(q) and all(len(line) == int(w) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+int(h)])
preconditions.description: The grid has exactly h rows, each with exactly w characters (either '.' or '#').
The top-left cell (house) and bottom-right cell (school) are always allowed ('.') and never blocked.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(ri) <= int(h) and 1 <= int(cj) <= int(w) and stdin.splitlines()[int(ri)-1][int(cj)-1] == '.' for day in range(int(q)) for ki in [int(stdin.splitlines()[1+int(h)+day*ki][0])] for ri, cj in [tuple(map(int, stdin.splitlines()[1+int(h)+day+ki+1+idx].split())) for idx in range(ki)])
preconditions.description: Each temporarily blocked cell (ri, cj) on any day is within grid bounds, is allowed ('.'), and is not the house or school.

preconditions.expression: all(ki >= 1 and ki <= 10 for ki in [int(stdin.splitlines()[1+int(h)+day*ki][0]) for day in range(int(q))])
preconditions.description: Each day has between 1 and 10 temporarily blocked cells (ki).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() in ['YES', 'NO'] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each day, output is either 'YES' or 'NO' (without quotes), indicating whether the day is interesting.
Each output line is exactly 3 characters long ('YES' or 'NO').

postconditions.expression: all(has_path_to_school_and_back(stdin, day_idx) == (stdout.splitlines()[day_idx].strip() == 'YES') for day_idx in range(int(q)))
postconditions.description: For each day, output 'YES' if and only if there exists a path from house (1,1) to school (h,w) and back to house without revisiting any cell except the house, avoiding permanently and temporarily blocked cells on that day.
